name: Six-category home page
purpose: Q34 visual review of the accepted two prominent plus four compact highlights and recent top-ten results.
prompt: Edit this six-category Home mockup while preserving the shared header, both prominent record fields, complete artwork, four-row Record book, all statistics, dates, and typography. Remove the entire unsolicited All-time history section at the bottom left, including every takeover, rename, and championship line; that manager timeline does not belong on Home. Let Recent records occupy that full-width lower region as a short unboxed two-row list, retaining Sample tight end, 33.8 benched points, Week 12 · 2025, then Sample manager E, 48.6-point winning margin, Week 10 · 2025. Above the two lead records, add one compact functional context line All-time records · Regular season. Do not introduce a new hero or tagline. In the Most productive pickup row, show Sample manager and Sample receiver together in the Holder cell, on two compact lines. In the dropped-player row, show Sample manager F and Sample running back together in its Holder cell. Keep the original six category names, results, links and all other content unchanged. No new sections, timeline events, badges, explanations, evidence actions, or update/status indicators.
initialPrompt: Desktop web home page for the Farls da bag fantasy-football history museum, edge-to-edge 1440 by 1100 proportions, no browser frame. Extend reference image 1's approved gallery and record-index composition with more categories. Its palette, typography and component character carry over, while evidence actions do not. Use one identical shared header: Farls da bag in Roboto Condensed heavy brand ink #230b52; Records, Managers, Seasons, Rivalries in the same condensed font and muted #51447f, with violet text and underline only on the selected section. Plain Sample stats at the far right. Match the accepted home reference's header scale, spacing, and white ground. Primary headings and team names use dark ink #0b1028; supporting dates use #51447f. No section is selected on Home. Two prominent records lead: Best season without a title, The Monkey Buccaneers, +24%, PPG above league average, 2024, authentic complete crest; Highest-scoring benched player, Sample receiver, 38.7 points in one game, Week 7 · 2023, with the portrait explicitly captioned 2025 Champion as the team avatar. Both link to View rankings. Below, the compact full-width Record book has four linked rows with holder, result and date: Unluckiest season / Sample manager C / 3.0 wins below expected / 2022; Most productive pickup / Sample receiver / 169.4 starting points / 2024; Dropped players who delivered elsewhere / Sample running back / 148.2 starting points elsewhere / 2024; Longest winning streak / Sample manager D / 11 games / 2021–2022. An All records link opens the complete collection. Then a small unboxed Recent records list: Sample tight end, 33.8 benched points, Week 12 · 2025; Sample manager E, 48.6-point winning margin, Week 10 · 2025. All-time history leads before recent results. All results are fictional. Preserve complete source artwork in padded rounded white frames. No calculations, evidence actions, update dates, status panels, taglines, explanatory paragraphs, badges, or nested cards.
approvalScope: Q34 expanded desktop Home composition approved by Sam. Phone adaptation remains pending. Figures are synthetic and original source artwork remains authoritative.
sourceArtworkAuthority: Keep original source artwork in implementation; generated artwork is only part of the layout preview.
